items.title: S&P Global Ratings upgrades RTX to A- on strong demand and debt reduction
items.summary: Investing.com -- S&P Global Ratings upgraded Rtx Corp's (NYSE:RTX) issuer and unsecured issue-level credit ratings to ‘A-’ from ‘BBB+’ on Friday, citing robust aerospace and defense demand alongside steady balance-sheet repair. The agency assigned a stable outlook and affirmed RTX’s ‘A-2’ short-term rating, projecting that the company will keep adjusted debt to EBITDA below 2.5x and funds from operations to debt above 30%.

items.title: Rare Earth Wars: U.S. General Sounds Alarm Over China's Military Leverage
items.summary: China has already used its grip on rare earths against Western factories and U.S. defense firms. Now a retired four-star general is warning it will do so again, and he's saying it as a director of the company the Army selected to negotiate a dysprosium and terbium plant on one of its own bases.

items.title: RTX (RTX) DeepStrike Test And DARPA Win Put Fresh Focus On Defense Tech
items.summary: RTX (NYSE:RTX) unit Raytheon completed a third flight test of its DeepStrike JR3 rocket for the U.S. Army's Joint Reduced Range Rocket program. The latest DeepStrike JR3 trial used a configuration intended to replace legacy training rockets in support of Army long range fires training. RTX secured a contract from DARPA under the PICASSO program to develop an all optical processing system for defense applications.
